senses.gloss: m. (חָרַם) exclusion, disassociation, esp. interdiction of travel between two countries at war with each other.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 38a:6">B. Bath. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעת ח׳</he> at a time when commercial intercourse was cut off.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 38b:1">Ib. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>יהודה</he> … <he>ח׳ דמו</he> Judaea and Galilee are generally to be considered as if in a state of interdiction (possession in one country is no valid claim when the owner lived in the other); Y. ib. III, 14ᵃ top.
